in_hebrew.name: Wallace
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Wallace הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Gaelic term 'Walh', which means 'foreigner' or 'stranger'. The name became popular among the Scottish and English peoples during the Middle Ages as a result of the incursions of the Welsh into Scotland. The name has been borne by many notable figures throughout history, including Wallace Shawn, an American actor, and Wallace Stevens, an influential American poet.
